verdict.rationale: Persona is an identity-verification SaaS that processes sensitive user data, so an AI-training opt-out is a fair privacy question for it. The evidence pack contains no documentation of any control that keeps customer data out of model training. Adjacent features such as webhook attribute blocklists and IP allowlists are different controls and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
